subject: Alderwell security intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@alderwell.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Alderwell security intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Marta,

Great to meet you and the Alderwell team on today’s call — thanks for the walkthrough of your ingestion and PHI tokenization needs. Quick recap and next steps we discussed: 

- Redwood offering: hosted inference with VPC private option; SOC 2 Type II report available for customers on our Trust Portal
- Alderwell asks: confirmation we support HIPAA (yes), details on data retention controls, and a copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for procurement
- Procurement will need our standard PO flow and a short attestation for data handling to include in their vendor questionnaire

Can you please: 
1) Share the vendor DDQ you mentioned (you can drop it here) — I’ve included Camila from security who will triage the technical Qs
2) Confirm timeline for procurement (when do you need the report/bridge letter by?)
3) Any preferred user emails for Trust Portal access so we can provision view-only credentials

I’ve attached a short intake checklist for procurement to speed review. Once I have the DDQ and preferred accounts, Camila will open a Trust Portal invite and we’ll pull the SOC 2 package and bridge letter for you.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally on a rapid turnaround.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Subject: Re: Alderwell security intake — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Jordan — thanks for the summary and for looping Camila in.

Attaching our DDQ (Alderwell_DDQ_20260830.xlsx) and our procurement PO template for reference. Procurement is targeting a vendor sign-off window by EOD next Thursday (2026-09-09) — would you be able to get the SOC 2 materials and a bridge letter to us before then? If not, an interim attestation (temporary bridge) would be acceptable for procurement with a follow-up when the full report is available.

Also: please provision read-only access for these three accounts so our security folks can view artifacts in your Trust Portal: m.ruiz@alderwell.com, secops@alderwell.com, procurement@alderwell.com

Two quick Qs from our side:
- Is the SOC 2 report cover period the most recent fiscal year (ending 2026-03-31)?
- Do you retain access logs for artifact downloads (we’ll need evidence for our audit trail)

Thanks — Marta Ruiz
Head of InfoSec, Alderwell Health

Action items I’d like help with:

No major blockers from my side. Camila, please confirm invites and any special download restrictions requested by Alderwell.
